tour.title: System Overview & Architectural Foundation
tour.description: Start with the system documentation, project rules, and entity-relationship schema to understand the university library domain, user approval workflows, and relational data architecture.

tour.title: Container Orchestration & Infrastructure
tour.description: Examine how Docker Compose coordinates PostgreSQL, Redis 7, the Django REST API, and Nginx frontend proxy for unified local and production deployments.

tour.title: Backend Bootstrap & Configuration
tour.description: Trace Django's startup sequence from settings configuration through WSGI/ASGI gateways and top-level URL routing to understand how middleware, database connections, and cache backends are initialized.

tour.title: User Authentication & Approval Workflows
tour.description: Explore role-based access control (Student, Librarian, Admin), email OTP verification, and JWT session handling in the accounts service.

tour.title: Book Catalog & Borrowing Workflows
tour.description: Dive into the books and borrowing management subsystems, featuring atomic database transactions, renewal state machines, and high-performance Redis cache layers.

tour.title: Recommendation Engine & Data Ingestion
tour.description: Understand how scikit-learn computes TF-IDF content similarity and collaborative filtering recommendations, supported by bulk CSV catalog ingestion.

tour.title: Frontend React Single-Page Application
tour.description: Follow the React client from the main mounting point and router configuration to authentication context providers and Axios API client layers.

tour.title: Automated Testing & Continuous Integration
tour.description: Review the comprehensive Pytest test suites, fixtures in conftest.py, end-to-end user journeys, and the automated GitHub Actions CI pipeline.
